author: ZimaOS Team
description: Bringing all of your home videos, music, and photos together into one place has never been easier. Your personal Emby Server automatically converts and streams your media on-the-fly to play on any device.
tagline: TAKE YOUR MEDIA ANYWHERE WITH EMBY
title: Emby(Nvidia GPU)
release_note:
- Update to Emby Server 4.10.1.0 stable.
- Improve search performance and Spotlight design and compatibility.
- Fix connections to certain SMB shares and intro detection on episodes without audio streams.
- Fix photo slideshow issues and improve TV display mode.
